description: Custom Calculator Query Tools - Discover, search, and analyze TIER 2E custom calculators (6 query tools for calculator management)

tools.name: custom_calculator_list
tools.short_description: List all custom calculators with usage statistics and filters
tools.description: List custom calculators from the database with optional filtering by category, active status, and minimum usage count. Returns calculator metadata including usage statistics, parameter count, and performance metrics. Use this to discover available custom calculators, identify popular calculators, or filter by category. BEFORE creating new calculator: Check this list to see if similar calculator exists. Returns: calculator_id, name, short_description, category, usage_count, last_used_at, is_active, is_template, parameter_count, avg_calculation_time_ms. Results ordered by active status (active first), then usage count (most used first), then name alphabetically. Draft calculators (is_active=false) only shown when explicitly filtered.

category.description: Optional: Filter by category. Common categories: 'custom_quote', 'specialty_substrate', 'rush_job', 'large_format', 'complex_finishing', 'seasonal_pricing', 'customer_specific', 'what_if_scenario'. Matches exact category name. Null returns all categories.

is_active.description: Optional: Filter by active status. true = production-ready calculators only, false = draft calculators only, null = all calculators (both active and draft). Default: null (show all).

min_usage_count.description: Optional: Minimum usage count to include. Use to find popular calculators. Example: min_usage_count=10 shows calculators used 10+ times. Default: 0 (all calculators).

returns.description: Success status, filters_applied (category, is_active, min_usage_count), calculator_count, and calculators array with calculator_id, name, short_description, category, usage_count, last_used_at, is_active, is_template, parameter_count, avg_calculation_time_ms, created_at, updated_at. On error: success=False with error message

examples.expected_result: Returns all production-ready custom calculators with usage stats and metadata
Returns active rush job calculators for expedited pricing
Returns frequently-used calculators sorted by usage_count descending
Returns all custom calculators (active and draft) ordered by active status then usage

Discovering available custom calculators for specific category

tools.name: custom_calculator_get_detail
tools.short_description: Get complete calculator definition including JSON, parameters, and components
tools.description: Retrieve complete details for a specific custom calculator including full JSON definition, usage statistics, and metadata. Returns everything about the calculator: inputs structure, calculation steps (formulas and components), parameter tracking, component tracking, usage instructions, and performance metrics. Use this to: inspect calculator logic, debug calculation issues, clone calculator structure, understand how calculator works, verify calculator configuration. BEFORE using: Get calculator_id from custom_calculator_list() or custom_calculator_search(). Returns: Full calculator record with json_definition (complete calculator configuration), parameter tracking (which pricing parameters used), component tracking (which components used), usage stats, and metadata.

calculator_id.description: REQUIRED: Calculator UUID from custom_calculator_list() or custom_calculator_search(). Must be valid UUID for existing calculator (active or draft).

returns.description: Success status, calculator record with: calculator_id, name, description, short_description, category, tags, json_definition (full JSONB), usage_instructions, is_active, is_template, usage_count, last_used_at, avg_calculation_time_ms, created_at, updated_at, parameter_count, step_count, component_count, parameters_used (array of parameter objects), components_used (array of component objects). On error: success=False with error message

tools.name: custom_calculator_search
tools.short_description: Search custom calculators by name, description, or tags (text search)
tools.description: Search custom calculators using text search across name, description, and tags. Returns ranked results by relevance score. Use this when you know what you're looking for but don't know exact calculator name. Search terms are case-insensitive and use partial matching (ILIKE '%term%'). Can also filter by specific tags. Relevance scoring: name match = 100 points, short_description match = 75 points, description match = 50 points, tag match = 25 points. Results ordered by relevance score (highest first), then usage_count (most used first). Returns: calculator_id, name, short_description, description, category, tags, usage_count, is_active, is_template, relevance_score. Use to discover calculators for specific materials, finishes, urgencies, or job types.

search_term.description: REQUIRED: Search term for name/description text search. Partial match, case-insensitive. Examples: 'vinyl' finds all vinyl calculators, 'rush' finds rush job calculators, '24' finds 24-hour calculators. Searches across name, short_description, and description fields.

search_tags.description: Optional: Filter by specific tags. Array of tag strings. Matches if calculator has ANY of the provided tags (OR logic). Examples: ['rush', '24-hour'], ['vinyl', 'outdoor'], ['laminate', 'die-cut']. Combine with search_term for refined search.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum results to return. Default: 20. Use lower limit for quick searches, higher for comprehensive discovery. Max recommended: 100.

returns.description: Success status, search_term used, tags_filter applied, result_count, and results array with: calculator_id, name, short_description, description, category, tags, usage_count, is_active, is_template, relevance_score (100=name match, 75=short_description, 50=description, 25=tag). Results ordered by relevance_score DESC, usage_count DESC. On error: success=False with error message

tools.name: custom_calculator_get_parameters
tools.short_description: Show which pricing parameters are used by calculators (impact analysis)
tools.description: Show which pricing parameters from calculator_pricing_parameters table are used by custom calculators. Critical for impact analysis before changing global parameters. Can filter by specific calculator or specific parameter. Returns parameter usage with override information: which calculators use which parameters, whether calculator has custom override, current global value, override value if exists. Use this BEFORE changing global pricing parameters to understand impact. Also useful for understanding calculator dependencies on pricing constants. Returns: calculator_name, parameter_name, source_table, formula_variable_name, is_overridden (true if custom override exists), current_value (global), override_value (calculator-specific), override_updated_at.

calculator_id.description: Optional: Filter to specific calculator UUID. Shows only parameters used by that calculator. Useful when inspecting single calculator's parameter dependencies. Null returns all calculators.

parameter_name.description: Optional: Filter to specific parameter name (e.g., 'labor_rate_trade', 'gst_rate', 'profit_margin_standard'). Shows all calculators using that parameter. Critical for impact analysis before changing parameter. Null returns all parameters.

returns.description: Success status, filters_applied (calculator_id, parameter_name), usage_count, and parameter_usage array with: calculator_name, parameter_name, source_table, formula_variable_name, is_overridden (boolean), current_value (global default), override_value (calculator-specific if exists), override_updated_at. Ordered by calculator_name, parameter_name. On error: success=False with error message

tools.name: custom_calculator_get_usage_stats
tools.short_description: Get usage statistics over time period (by calculator, category, or day)
tools.description: Retrieve usage statistics for custom calculators over specified time period with flexible grouping. Three grouping options: by calculator (per-calculator stats), by category (category rollups), by day (time-series data). Shows: quote count, average quote value, total revenue, usage trends. Use for: monitoring calculator adoption, identifying popular calculators, analyzing revenue by category, tracking usage over time, identifying underutilized calculators. Data from quote_history_archive table (auto-populated when calculators execute). Returns aggregated statistics with flexible time window (default 30 days). Critical for business intelligence and calculator ROI analysis.

days.description: Optional: Number of days to analyze. Default: 30 (last 30 days). Examples: 7 (last week), 90 (last quarter), 365 (last year). Analyzes from NOW() - INTERVAL 'X days' to NOW().

group_by.description: REQUIRED: How to group statistics. 'calculator' = per-calculator breakdown, 'category' = category rollups, 'day' = daily time-series. Default: 'calculator'. Choose based on analysis need.

returns.description: Success status, time_period (days analyzed), group_by used, and stats array. If group_by='calculator': calculator_name, category, total_quotes, avg_quote_value, total_revenue, usage_trend. If group_by='category': category, calculator_count, total_quotes, avg_quote_value, total_revenue. If group_by='day': quote_date, total_quotes, unique_calculators, avg_quote_value, total_revenue. On error: success=False with error message

examples.expected_result: Returns stats for each calculator: quote count, average value, total revenue, usage trend (increasing/stable)

tools.name: custom_calculator_get_components
tools.short_description: List component usage across calculators (which logic is most reused)
tools.description: List reusable components usage across all custom calculators. Shows which of the 11 pre-built components (tiered_pricing_lookup, calculate_gst, quantity_break_discount, etc.) are most commonly used. Returns: component_name, component_type, calculator_count (how many calculators use it), total_usage (sum of usage across all calculators), avg_usage_per_calculator, calculator_list (which calculators use it), avg_performance_impact_ms. Use for: understanding component popularity, identifying most valuable components, documenting component dependencies, analyzing performance impact of components, discovering reusable patterns. Can filter to specific component for detailed usage analysis.

component_name.description: Optional: Filter to specific component name. Must match one of 11 available components: 'tiered_pricing_lookup', 'quantity_break_discount', 'calculate_profit_margin', 'apply_complexity_multiplier', 'calculate_gst', 'calculate_double_gst_shopify', 'calculate_area_m2', 'calculate_labor_cost', 'calculate_material_waste', 'calculate_setup_cost', 'minimum_order_check'. Null returns all components.

returns.description: Success status, component_filter applied, component_count, and components array with: component_name, component_type, calculator_count (unique calculators using it), total_usage (sum across all calculators), avg_usage_per_calculator, calculator_list (JSONB array of calculator names), avg_performance_impact_ms. Ordered by total_usage DESC, calculator_count DESC. On error: success=False with error message
